title: Your own audience and a co-leader

outline.heading: Who will really fill the group

points.text: Leaders often invite a co-leader for their audience: more followers, their own studio or a book.
The most common mistake is not agreeing in writing with someone close.

points: You might invite a co-leader because they have an audience, such as their own followers, studio, or book.
You should avoid the common mistake of failing to create a written agreement when working with someone close.
